cover.title: which country pays you in euros

inner.title: group by billing country
inner.body: export your paid invoices and sum them by the customer's billing country. your traffic map shows where people look, not where euros come from.
inner.label: follow the euros

inner.title: traffic isn't buyers
inner.body: eurostat says 96% of irish internet users bought online in 2024, against 57% in bulgaria. the same visit count can hide very different wallets.
inner.label: 96% vs 57%

inner.title: one price, two wallets
inner.body: in 2024 eurostat put denmark's price level at 143% of the eu average, bulgaria's at 60%. your €29 plan is cheap in one and steep in the other.
inner.label: 143% vs 60%

inner.title: euros per visitor
inner.body: divide each country's revenue by its visitors and rank them. your biggest traffic country is not automatically the one paying most per head.
inner.label: small can win

inner.title: count the refunds
inner.body: subtract refunds and chargebacks per country before you rank anything. a country that buys a lot and refunds a lot is not your best market.
inner.label: net, not gross
